content.value: At the instant shown, car A travels with a speed of 25 mis, which is decreasing at a constant 17 rate of 2 $\mathrm { m } / \mathrm { s } ^ { 2 }$ while car B travels with speed 15 mis, which is increasing at a constant rate of $3 \mathrm { m } / \mathrm { s } ^ { 2 }$ <sup>.</sup> Determine the velocity and acceleration of car A with respect to car B. Also determine the velocity and acceleration of B with respect to car A.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
